owner.name: Edmund Greywood
owner.disposition: The master he has served for forty years; the last thing he was ever bidden to do was the wall he plastered over with his own hands

chara.name: Winnie
chara.disposition: The young lady he watched grow up; he dreads nothing more than her going down into the cellar — unless it is her coming to hate her uncle

player.disposition: An outsider, sent for by Miss Winnie; perfectly courteous, but not trusted
